sections.thesis: Australian inflation quickened in the third quarter, bolstering the case for a rate hike by the Reserve Bank of Australia.

sentences.text: Australian inflation quickened in the third quarter, bolstering the case for a rate hike by the Reserve Bank of Australia.

sections.thesis: The New Zealand dollar sank below 0.5600 against the US dollar after the central bank's surprise decision to hold rates.

sections.thesis: Tech stocks rose on Tuesday, buoyed by lower oil prices and the confidence Anthropic's IPO documents gave investors.

sentences.text: Tech stocks rose on Tuesday, buoyed by lower oil prices and the confidence Anthropic's IPO documents gave investors.

sections.thesis: Brent crude fell 1.7% on Tuesday but remained just under $114 a barrel as attacks on Gulf shipping continued.
